review_standard: same-context adversarial review; no Option-B independence claim

findings.summary: Rejected both local-only framing and a speculative forge-administration API in canonical Qor; Phase 241 defines a portable-engine boundary only.
Separated model/host execution adaptation from downstream enterprise enforcement so the two platform concepts cannot share authority accidentally.
Public tracked files identified a private downstream repository/issue. Iteration 3 keeps the downstream consumer generic and moves cross-project identity to issue/PR metadata.

residuals_disclosed: the no-platform-administration boundary is architectural until a future base change attempts to add such a surface
downstream adapters require explicit coverage semantics because not every Qor obligation has a native platform equivalent
private downstream implementation identity is intentionally excluded from canonical tracked content
same-context review is not Option-B independent review
